text:
maria: FYI console is showing a sudden increase in tenants with a 'compat-risk' badge but opt-out counts look wrong. :confused:

akash: Likely metric name split: legacy proxy -> deprec_optout_v1, router -> deprec_optout_v2. Console reads v1 only.

jess: Can we join both in the short term? PMs need usable numbers.

akash: Yes, I'll emit a provisional derived metric platform.deprec.optout.prov that sums both and tags source=proxy|router.

sam: We also need tenant exemptions so migration cohorts don't trigger alerts. Add tenant metadata compat_exempt and an admin-only toggle with audit logs.

maria: UX: show a small "Provisional" label and sampling rate + last reconciliation timestamp next to the badge.

jess: Backfill: full 30d backfill is heavy. Suggest targeted ETL for tenants already flagged and with quota anomalies.

akash: I'll emit canonical name from both codepaths now to simplify aggregation, and add the path tag for debugging.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: console-feature-flags v2026.03.21-provisional -> canary (5%) :rocket:

sam: I'll mock the exempt pill + audit log entry (actor, ts, reason) and add a disclosure about provisional counts.

maria: Plan: 1) canary provisional meter join today 2) exemptions API + UI in ~4 days 3) switch to canonical metric after 7-10 days of stable checks and run a targeted backfill. Ping #release-war-room if we see >10% discrepancy.

jess: Opening infra ticket for ETL and tagging you all now.

maria: Thanks — keep me posted.
